Reply in English with a short greeting.

Houston,

I am writing to you in English with a short greeting. I hope this message finds you well and that your journey through the United States is as smooth as possible.

As for my language proficiency, I have been studying Spanish since I was a child, and it has always fascinated me. I believe that learning another language can greatly enhance your understanding of the world around you.

I am here to assist you in any way I can, whether through translation or simply sharing stories about your journey across the United States. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to ask.

Reply in English: What is the capital of Brazil?
The capital of Brazil is Brasília.

hits.snippet: Brasília (/ brəˈzɪliə / brə-ZIL-ee-ə; [3][4] Brazilian Portuguese: [bɾaˈziliɐ, bɾaˈziljɐ] ⓘ) is the capital city of Brazil and the Federal District. Located in the Brazilian Highlands in the country's Central-West region, it was founded by President Juscelino Kubitschek on 21 April 1960, to replace Rio de Janeiro as the national capital . hits.title: Brasilia | Facts, History, Map, Pronunciation & Architecture | Britannica
hits.snippet: Brasilia is the capital of Brazil . Located in the Federal District within Goias state on the central plateau of Brazil , it lies between the headwaters of the Tocantins, Parana, and Sao Francisco rivers. Because of its unique city plan and architecture, it was designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1987.
